title: CenterSeat
blurb: A movie-seat ranking project that compares seats together across showtimes.
overview: CenterSeat compares seats across nearby showtimes and ranks contiguous seats. Live searches require a configured data provider.
features: Code and setup are available on GitHub
Live searches require a configured provider

title: Boilerplate
blurb: My macOS and Linux workspace setup, managed with chezmoi and mise.
overview: Boilerplate is a cross-platform workspace setup managed with chezmoi and mise. The repository includes setup notes for macOS and Linux.

title: Jeopardy study platform
blurb: A Jeopardy study platform with search and practice tools.
overview: This study platform brings search, practice modes, full boards, answer validation, and progress tracking into one place.

title: OpenCode Monitor
blurb: A small macOS menu bar app for keeping an OpenCode server under control.
overview: OpenCode Monitor keeps server status, start and stop controls, logs, updates, and optional idle shutdown in a macOS menu bar app.

title: AudioReader
blurb: A local audiobook player with synchronized transcription captions.
overview: AudioReader serves local audio in a browser and pairs playback with VTT captions generated from transcription.

title: Farkle Scorer
blurb: An offline iOS Farkle scorer with tap-to-score dice and nearby multiplayer experiments.
overview: Farkle Scorer handles visual dice selection, manual entry for physical dice, house rules, and optional nearby multiplayer exploration.

title: Flipping Seven Calculator
blurb: An iOS scorekeeper for Flip 7 with round history and undo.
overview: Flipping Seven Calculator keeps score on iPhone and iPad with card taps, bonuses, round history, undo, and local persistence.

title: Spotify DJ
blurb: An earlier experiment in ordering playlists by BPM, key, and danceability.
overview: Spotify DJ analyzes playlist audio features and suggests an order based on BPM, key, danceability, and energy. Check the repository setup before running it.

title: Physical computing final
blurb: A college physical-computing project built around a garden owl.
overview: This college physical-computing project explored a garden owl with camera, light, and sound sensors, alongside a documented data flow.

title: ComicScanner
blurb: An earlier comic-cataloging project with image matching and barcode scanning.
overview: ComicScanner is the earlier version of a comic-catalog idea, with barcode scanning, metadata lookup, image matching, and collection management.

title: RSS News Summarizer
blurb: An RSS reader experiment that summarizes feeds in a small web interface.
overview: RSS News Summarizer reads feeds, aggregates sources, and writes short summaries in a web interface.

title: Spotify Preference Analyst
blurb: A music-analysis project that maps listening preferences with audio features and distance math.
overview: Spotify Preference Analyst explores listening patterns with audio features, Euclidean distance, and visualizations.
